Hình7.1.visual_description: A four-callout FTZ infographic surrounds a central blue hexagon with a globe and opposing arrows. Dashed arrows link a seaport crane/container ship and stacks of goods to people checking goods and documents. The callouts describe a gateway port (and note it may be an airport), permitted assembly, display, storage, production, processing, packing, and product inspection; benefits including import-tax relief, lower operating costs, faster customs, and tax refund on re-export; and reduced or refunded taxes when goods leave the FTZ for the domestic market or are re-exported. A blue strip below the ship reads 'Biển Quốc Tế' (International Sea).
